description: This Dart file defines a Flutter widget for a login screen with email and password fields, including validation, loading state management, and navigation upon login success or failure.

classes.name: LoginScreen
classes.description: Main widget that renders the login form, handles user input validation, and manages authentication flow.

methods.name: createState
methods.description: Creates the mutable state for the LoginScreen widget.

methods.name: _LoginScreenState
methods.description: State class managing the login form, input controllers, validation, loading state, and navigation.

methods.name: dispose
methods.description: Disposes of the text controllers when the widget is removed from the widget tree.

methods.name: _validateEmail
methods.description: Validates the email input to ensure it is not empty and contains '@' and '.' characters.

methods.name: _validatePassword
methods.description: Validates the password input to ensure it is not empty and has at least 6 characters.

methods.name: _submit
methods.description: Handles the login process by validating inputs, calling the AuthProvider login method, and navigating or showing errors accordingly.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget tree for the login screen UI, including input fields, buttons, and layout.
